owner_request: 2026-10-11: after the bar-by-bar read of ETHUSDT.P 1m 2026-10-08 23:01-23:09 Beijing (six SPIKE V13.1 MAs SMA/EMA 20/60/120), 「把上面几条特征写成规则去扫历史数据」
question: Do the features of the owner's ETH 1m example (a tight, tangled six-MA knot, the first close beyond all six MAs, and the extra features of that read) pick entries that beat matched random entries with the same stop distance and 3R/5R targets after 0.2% cost, in both periods, on 1m majors and on 5m/15m/30m/1H?
prior_evidence: exp-owner-squeeze-breakout-20261008-v1 (SPIKE dense rope <= 3 ATR / >= 2 flips + BB + engulfing breakout + volume, same exits): no timeframe passed; 5m about -0.2R net per trade from cost alone. New here: a far tighter knot (0.7 ATR, 10 flips) taken from the example, the first close beyond all six MAs as the trigger, 1m data, and single added conditions read one at a time.

rule.knot: mean (max MA - min MA) / ATR14 over the 12 bars before <= 0.7 and >= 10 pairwise MA order flips over those 12 bars
rule.break: close beyond all six MAs in the trade direction, previous close not beyond them
rule.close: close in the outer 20% of the bar range
rule.volume: volume / median of the 20 bars before >= 1.5
rule.fakeout: one of the 12 bars before closed beyond all six MAs on the other side with volume ratio >= 3
rule.htf: last closed higher-timeframe bar fully stacked in the trade direction (both 20s beyond both 60s beyond both 120s); 1m->5m, 5m->15m, 15m->1H, 30m->2H, 1H->4H
rule.lower_highs: this bar and the two before each made a lower high (higher low for longs)
rule.confirm: decision at the first bar from the break up to 4 bars after it where EMA20 is the outermost MA, every close since the break beyond all six MAs
rule.threshold_source: single owner example (2026-10-08 23:02 break: 0.67 ATR, 10 flips, close position 0.00, rv 1.57, fake-out rv 5.0/12.3, 5m stack, 3 lower highs); nothing tuned on the scanned data, which ends before the example

variant_notes: primary = knot + break. knot_v131 swaps the knot for SPIKE V13.1 dense (3.0 ATR, 2 flips), knot_loose for 1.0 ATR / 6 flips; plus_* add one condition; confirm moves the decision; replica stacks every condition and is descriptive only
stop: long: min(six MAs at the decision bar) - 0.2 ATR14; short: max(six MAs) + 0.2 ATR14; skip when the entry is not beyond the stop
exit_path: as exp-owner-squeeze-breakout-20261008-v1: bar high/low from the entry bar, gaps fill at the open, stop first when both print in one bar, exit at the close after max_hold_bars, a missing bar before the exit drops the trade

controls.pool: same symbol, timeframe and calendar month, ready bars, not the event bar, ATR/price within 0.5-2x the event's
controls.stop: same stop distance in ATR units as the event

data.1m: Binance USD-M monthly 1m archives (checksum verified, yoyo.data.binance_um_archives.fetch_symbol) for BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP/DOGE/BNB USDT, 2022-11 to 2026-09, at data/research/ma6_knot_1m_20261011
data.5m_source: frozen Binance USD-M 5m series data/research/spike_v128_entry_clock_long_20260923/series, complete-bucket resampling; per month the top 100 alts by previous-month median daily quote volume (stables excluded) plus BTC/ETH
data.example_check: OKX ETH-USDT-SWAP 1m data/research/spike_v129_eth5m_20261010 (2026-09-22 to 2026-10-10): which variants fire at the example break

primary: per timeframe, side and target, variant primary: mean net R and excess over matched controls in each period; a timeframe qualifies only if both periods are net positive after cost and excess is positive with month-block sign-flip p < 0.05 in at least one. Variants are single changes read against primary; with 10 variants x 5 timeframes x 2 sides x 2 targets, an isolated p < 0.05 cell is expected by chance
